description: This Java source file defines the utility class PartyRelationshipHelper, which provides methods for querying active party relationships from a database using the OFBiz framework. It includes logic for constructing database queries based on entity conditions related to party relationship data and filters for active relationships based on date conditions.

classes.name: PartyRelationshipHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing methods to retrieve active party relationship records based on specified criteria within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getActivePartyRelationships
methods.description: Returns a list of active party relationship records matching the input criteria, filtering for relationships that are currently valid based on 'fromDate' and 'thruDate'.
